means: A genre label rather than a drawing technique: contemporary TV sports anime - clean digital colour, hard cel shading, uniformed athletes, floodlit or daylit action.
does: Sets the WORLD, not the line. It is a compound phrase and not a single trained danbooru tag, so what actually lands is the priors its parts drag in - 'sports' pulls kit, pitch, stadium and crowd, 'modern' pushes toward clean digital colour rather than 90s cel. That is also why it works at all: the parts it decomposes into name THINGS. The drawing itself is still decided by cel shading and the line tags sitting next to it.
reach_for_it: at the head of a film house style tag when the subject is athletes, so every unrelated shot inherits the same kit-and-stadium world
used_in: the house style tag of derby-ep1 and derby-qwen
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
